before.name: files
before.sql:
CREATE TABLE files (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT file_size_nonnegative CHECK (size >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

before.name: shares
before.sql:
CREATE TABLE shares (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	file_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT share_state_valid CHECK (state IN ('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled','revoked')), 
	CONSTRAINT different_recipient CHECK (owner_id != recipient_id), 
	CONSTRAINT share_revision_positive CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES files (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

after.name: shares
after.sql:
CREATE TABLE "shares" (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	file_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	return_reason VARCHAR DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	supplement_text VARCHAR DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT share_state_valid CHECK (state IN ('pending','awaiting_supplement','approved','rejected','cancelled','revoked')), 
	CONSTRAINT different_recipient CHECK (owner_id != recipient_id), 
	CONSTRAINT share_revision_positive CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES files (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	CONSTRAINT supplement_text_limit CHECK (length(return_reason) <= 200 AND length(supplement_text) <= 200)
)
